title: 25 Most Iconic Celebrity Engagement Rings
audience: Couples in their 30s, affluent, interested in destination weddings and luxury celebrations, AUD 150k+ budget
notes: Fast mode: 02, 03 and 04 in parallel after the brief; 5 SERP cities; editor and readers in parallel; one combined final pass.

Real people: every ring detail sourced with URL and date (reputable news, Vogue/Harper's Bazaar, official statements, auction houses). Carats as 'reported as about X carats'. Unsourced details left out.
No prices or valuations. Designer or house names allowed as attributed facts only (no links, no endorsement).
Images: no celebrity photos unless licensed by the team (editorial agency); AI never for real people. Placeholders with shot briefs.
Respectful tone: no gossip, divorce speculation or relationship claims beyond the engagement facts.
Our angle: a 'Get the look' line per ring linking to /style-advice/engagement-ring-styles and who it suits.
Person's standards: exactly 4 one-sentence Key takeaways; Advisor claims only from brand-facts.md; business details deferred.
